blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives leadership has confirmed the passing of Batanes Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr., with the chamber’s members offering prayers for the late lawmaker. During the session late Monday night, as the House held plenary debates on the proposed 2027 national budget, Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Emano who was presiding over session called on members to stand up and offer prayers for Gato. “Before we proceed, Majority Leader, can we all please rise for a moment of silence and offer a prayer for our beloved colleague, the Honorable Ciriaco Gato, who passed away earlier today,” Emano said.
